narrative.intro: Richard Group has $65.4M in contract obligations for FY27 to date. Historical obligations show swings across recent fiscal years: FY22 obligations were $169M, FY23 obligations were $265M, FY24 obligations were $151M, FY25 obligations were $34.1M, and FY26 obligations were $48.3M. The current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, and the note clarifies that the figures are contract obligations except for award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables. The data shows that FY23 was the largest single-year total listed, and FY25 was the smallest. This pattern indicates variability in annual federal demand for Richard Group without implying causes or future results. Use these figures for contract planning, pipeline sizing, or competitive benchmarking where only stated obligations and award counts are required.
